description: Phase 1: process a begins a transaction and inserts row 201 (N 2010); process b (no transaction) inserts rows 202 (N 2020) and 203 (N 11, inside the low key range); a inserts row 204 and keeps the file image, then rolls back; b reads the row count and rows above 200 and inserts row 201 again; a reads the same. Phase 2: a begins, inserts 211; b inserts 212 and 213; a commits; b and a read. Asks which inserts are admitted beside another process's uncommitted insert and what survives each resolution.
